SPJIMR ranks 26th globally and 2nd in India in FT Masters in Management 2026 ranking

The Financial Times released its 2026 Masters in Management global ranking. The ranking placed S.P. Jain Institute of Management and Research (SPJIMR) at 26th position worldwide. SPJIMR was ranked second among Indian institutions in the same list. The FT’s methodology notes that European schools dominate the top spots while demand for the degree is spreading globally. Indian media outlets The Hindu (left‑leaning) and BusinessLine (centrist) reported the SPJIMR result, highlighting the school’s rise in the global ranking. No additional commentary or divergent claims were presented by the Indian outlets.
